pages.title: Finding Manganese
pages.text: Default deposits: Overworld, Y 16 to 128. Veins target up to 8 blocks, with 10 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 2.

pages.title: Working Manganese
pages.text: Smelt Manganese Ore or Manganese Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.
